_comment: Home film. When video is null the 3D clay room plays. To use a real film, run scripts/encode-hero.sh on the master file and fill video in (paths are under public/). alarmAt is the scroll progress (0-1) where the clock hits 1:00 PM; shots are the progress points where captions change: [asleep, alarm, up, walk, at work, title].

video.alt: Animated film still: a young man with curly hair and glasses at his desk editing video on two monitors, seen through the open window of a sunny apartment building in an Indian city.
video.source: Made by Vikas Banjare in Google Flow (Veo), 10 s, 16 Oct 2026; encoded with scripts/encode-hero.sh
